answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a refundable work bond before joining a task grove: the bond is locked in shared escrow and returned only after peers verify completed work. An attacker spawning thousands of hollow identities must fund every bond, so cost scales with fake agents instead of being nearly free. Peers then attest work through a canyon of independent checks - reputation, stake, and task history - so no forged identity can vouch for itself, and any bond caught cheating is slashed and redistributed to honest verifiers.
